correctness.rationale: The normalized second-Hermite radial density t^(j−2)[t²−2jt+j(j−1)]² e^(−t)/(2j!) integrates to the eigenvalue for all integers j>=0; apparent negative powers at j=0,1 cancel. Differentiation gives λ_(j+1)−λ_j=−e^(−s)s^(j−1)Q_j(s)Q_(j+1)(s)/(2(j+1)!). The quadratic in index Q_j(s) has positive tails and a negative integer entry for all s>0, hence absence of positive gaps forces each sign transition to occur at an integer root. Both roots integral exactly at s=k(k+1), k>=1, with roots k²,(k+1)². At these values only four equality edges exist, forming two separated triple plateaus. This verifies the quantified all-radius, all-index statement analytically; finite checker and low j=0 boundary are supplementary.
